commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
90+7' James Hill (Bournemouth) is yellow-carded.
90+6' Foul! Djed Spence (Tottenham) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
90+4' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) jumps into a tackle and Simon Hooper signals a foul.
90+3' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Djordje Petrovic comes off the line to clear the ball away.

90+2' What a chance that is! Mathys Tel (Tottenham) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
90' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Tottenham.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The attendance for today's match is 61250.
88' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
86' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
83' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcus Tavernier trots off the pitch and is replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth).
81' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Evanilson and he is replaced by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
79' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
78' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Substitution. Mathys Tel (Tottenham) in, Pape Matar Sarr out.

72' Djordje Petrovic (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pedro Porro as he is replaced by Destiny Udogie (Tottenham).
69' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

69' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Djordje Petrovic pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the middle of the target.
68' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempts to feed Evanilson with a chip pass, but Guglielmo Vicario reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
66' A rebound spins to Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
65' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Djed Spence (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
64' Tottenham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
64' Here is a change. Alex Scott is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
63' Substitution. David Brooks walks off the pitch and Amine Adli (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.
62' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) and blew his whistle.
58' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is able to continue to play.
58' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
57' Tottenham keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
54' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) replaces Joao Palhinha.
54' It's time for a substitution. Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) comes on in place of Brennan Johnson.

53' David Brooks (Bournemouth) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Guglielmo Vicario easily makes the save.
53' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
50' David Brooks (Bournemouth) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
50' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
49' That was a wasted opportunity to score by Evanilson (Bournemouth). He picks up the rebound and produces a poor effort which is easily saved by the goalkeeper.
47' Bournemouth quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

47' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Guglielmo Vicario blocks the shot with his legs.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+1' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Bournemouth are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

43' A cross is whipped in towards Evanilson (Bournemouth) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.

32' The referee blows his whistle as James Hill (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in his challenge.
31' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by David Brooks (Bournemouth) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
30' Richarlison (Tottenham) commits a foul and Simon Hooper immediately signals a free kick.
29' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
28' A pass lands at the feet of Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
28' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
26' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Adam Smith leaves the pitch to be replaced by James Hill (Bournemouth).
26' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
25' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Simon Hooper blows for a foul after Adam Smith (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

22' David Brooks (Bournemouth) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
22' Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' David Brooks (Bournemouth) stands over the resulting free kick from long range and fires a shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
20' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) brings an opponent down and Simon Hooper interrupts the game. That's a free kick to Bournemouth.
19' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
17' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
16' Tottenham exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
14' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
14' Tottenham move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
12' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
11' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
10' Tottenham showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
9' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
8' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

7' Evanilson (Bournemouth) is lurking on the edge of the box and receives a pass from Antoine Semenyo. He shows nice control before hitting a soft shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
6' Bournemouth are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcos Senesi plays a long ball to Evanilson (Bournemouth), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the right of the goal. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:1.
4' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
3' Djordje Petrovic (Bournemouth) sends a long ball in, but Guglielmo Vicario comfortably gathers the ball.
